import idaapi, idautils, ida_funcs, idc, ida_search
from collections import defaultdict
ids = [1000,1001,1002,1007,1005,1006,1009]
hits = defaultdict(set)
for imm in ids:
    ea = 0
    while True:
        ea = ida_search.find_imm(ea, ida_search.SEARCH_DOWN, imm)
        if ea == idaapi.BADADDR:
            break
        f = ida_funcs.get_func(ea)
        if f:
            hits[f.start_ea].add(imm)
        ea = idc.next_head(ea)
        if ea == idaapi.BADADDR:
            break
ranked = sorted(((len(v), k, sorted(v)) for k,v in hits.items()), reverse=True)
out = []
for score, addr, found in ranked:
    if score >= 3:
        name = idc.get_func_name(addr)
        size = ida_funcs.get_func(addr).size()
        out.append("%d %s %s size=%s ids=%s" % (score, hex(addr), name, hex(size), found))
print("\n".join(out[:50]))
